architecture: character-level MLP language model, 3-character context (Bengio et al. 2003 style)
alphabet_note: index i is alphabet[i]: 0 is the space, 1 the full stop, 2..27 are a..z
padding: positions before the first character of the text are the space (index 0)
forward: x = concat(emb[c1], emb[c2], emb[c3]) for the three previous characters, oldest first (48 values); h = tanh(hidden.weight @ x + hidden.bias); logits = out.weight @ h + out.bias; p(next) = softmax(logits). See FORWARD.md.
normalization_steps: Unicode NFKD, combining marks removed, lower-cased
a-z kept; each of . ! ? becomes a full stop; every other character becomes a space
every run of spaces and full stops that contains a full stop becomes ". "
runs of spaces become one space; leading and trailing spaces removed
normalization_python:
import re
import unicodedata


def normalize(text):
    text = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', text)
    text = ''.join(c for c in text if not unicodedata.combining(c)).lower()
    text = ''.join(c if 'a' <= c <= 'z' else '.' if c in '.!?' else ' ' for c in text)
    text = re.sub(r'[ .]*\.[ .]*', '. ', text)
    return re.sub(r' +', ' ', text).strip()
